draws.text:
Use sacrificers to earn
 sacrifice points, you will
  need them for other
   purchases.

drag fireball around for
  a while to grow it. This
   will result in bigger
     explosions.

Flick creeps into ground
   for bigger damage.

Door updates are
  disabled in this level, 
   be careful!

If you can't pass the level,
 lower the difficulty using
   Options menu.

Touch hidden Assassin
to reveal his position, or
  simply grab and flick
    him into sky.

Titans are tough. Smash
 them into the ground
   or drop them at least
     twice to kill.

Wizards cast protection -
 grab them before they
   do it!

This level is absolutely
   random - expect
     anything!

Door upgrade will be
  available after day 8.

Now use all you've learned
 to sustain the full power
 of enemy forces.
